Three practical reasons, specific to this city.

items: Villa Park is the smallest city in Orange County, with largely half-acre single-family lots, almost no commercial base and effectively no event parking or nightlife.

The realistic use case is a chauffeured vehicle that runs a large family group from the high school or a private home to Disneyland, the Packing District or a restaurant and back, with parking solved entirely by the driver.
The city is enclosed by Orange and sits just off the I-5, SR 22, SR 55 and SR 57 interchange cluster.

blocks.text: Choosing a Vehicle for a Villa Park Night

Capacity is the first filter, then cost per person. A stretch limo seats 6 to 8, a Chrysler 300 about 8, a Hummer 12, and a Sprinter limo up to 14. Our party bus seats 24. Below about ten people, two cars or a limo usually beats a bus. Above ten, the bus wins on cost per head and nobody gets left behind.
